summaryZh: Towers 实验室研究癌细胞的回收过程，尤其是自噬被抑制后细胞如何维持细胞器稳态并获取营养。团队使用全基因组 CRISPR/Cas9 编辑、超分辨显微术、光遗传学及生物化学，在细胞系、患者和小鼠来源三维类器官与基因工程小鼠模型中寻找代偿机制和治疗靶点。
researchQuestions: 当自噬失活时，癌细胞如何避免受损蛋白质或线粒体的积累？
这些适应机制能否预测患者对自噬抑制的响应？
能否靶向这些适应过程来改善癌症患者的结局？
methods: 全基因组 CRISPR/Cas9 编辑

evidence.quote: In the Towers lab we study cellular recycling processes in cancer cells.
We are interested in the specific mechanisms autophagy-dependent cancer cells can employ to maintain organelle homeostasis and generate nutrients when autophagy is blocked.

We use multi-disciplinary cell biology and molecular biology techniques including genome-wide CRISRR/Cas9 editing, super resolution microscopy, optogenetics, and biochemistry to study autophagy in cancer models including cultured cell lines, patient and mouse derived 3D-organoids, and genetically engineered mouse models.
In particular, how can cancer cells avoid the buildup of damaged proteins or mitochondria – two molecules autophagy is necessary for the clearance of – when autophagy is inactivated?
Do these mechanisms of adaptation predict patient response to autophagy inhibition?
Can we target these adaptations to improve cancer patient outcome?
